column1: # Guest functions the host runtime implements itself (hook_<name>).
# XAPI peripherals (XPP section): the USB stack cannot run without hardware.
# XAPI pieces that talk to hardware or the real kernel in ways we skip.
# Direct3D 8 (D3D section): the real library drives the GPU; hooks_d3d.c fakes it.
# DirectSound (DSOUND section): the real library drives the audio processor; hooks_dsound.c fakes it.
# XGraphics shader assembler (STL + C++ exceptions inside; the output is only fed back to D3D)
# DirectSound entry points the game calls directly (all of them; found by scanning the generated code)
# D3D helpers the game calls directly besides the API (found by scanning the generated code)
# vertex shaders: the source from XGAssembleShader is translated by the host (shader_xlate.c)
